description: This file contains helper functions for testing chart loading states in a web application using Playwright. It includes functions to wait for charts to load, verify their states, and retrieve chart IDs.

methods.name: waitForAllChartsToLoad
methods.description: Waits for all chart cards on the page to reach the 'loaded' state, returning their loading results.

methods.name: expectAllChartsToLoad
methods.description: Asserts that all charts on the page have loaded successfully; throws error if any failed.

methods.name: getChartLoadingState
methods.description: Retrieves the current loading state of a specific chart by its ID.

methods.name: waitForChartToLoad
methods.description: Waits for a specific chart to reach the 'loaded' state.

methods.name: getAllChartIds
methods.description: Returns an array of all chart IDs present on the page.
